notes: The six recognized ResignAction values are taken directly from the official IEEE 1516.1-2025 C++ API Enums.h. The setter's declared InvalidResignAction exception and service clause are taken from RTIambassador.h §10.45. This slice does not exercise automatic resignation, object deletion, or ownership cleanup.

requirements.statement: The setter accepts the standard ResignAction type. The test sets each enumerator listed in RTI/Enums.h lines 34-42 and confirms that getAutomaticResignDirective returns the same value.

The API declares InvalidResignAction for the setter. After testing the six standard enumerators from RTI/Enums.h lines 34-42, the test passes the next representable enumerator value and requires InvalidResignAction.
